# n8n_credential_smtp (Resource)

Manages an n8n SMTP credential (`smtp`) via the Public API for the Send Email node.

Provide `user`, write-only `password`, `host`, and typically `port` / `secure`. Optional `disable_start_tls` and `host_name`. Terraform 1.11 or later is required for write-only attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "n8n_credential_smtp" "example" {
  name              = "smtp"
  user              = "alerts@example.com"
  password          = "placeholder"
  host              = "smtp.example.com"
  port              = 465
  secure            = true
  data_version      = 1
  delete_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `data_version` (Number) Keeper for write-only secrets. Create always sends credential data. Update sends data when this value changes or when a non-secret payload attribute changes.
- `delete_protection` (Boolean) When set to `true`, prevents Terraform from destroying this credential. This flag is Terraform-only; n8n has no matching API field. Imported resources default to `true`.
- `host` (String) SMTP host, for example `smtp.example.com`.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMTP password or app password. Write-only; never stored in state.
- `user` (String) SMTP username / mailbox address.

### Optional

- `disable_start_tls` (Boolean) When SSL/TLS is off, prevent opportunistic STARTTLS upgrades.
- `host_name` (String) Client host name (FQDN) sent to the SMTP server. Leave empty unless your provider requires it.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this credential is available globally. Applied after create via update. Community n8n returns 403 when set to true.
- `is_partial_data` (Boolean) When true, n8n merges payload fields into the stored secret object on update. When false, the payload replaces the entire object. OAuth types default to true so omitted oauth_token_data does not wipe UI-obtained tokens.
- `is_resolvable` (Boolean) Whether this credential has resolvable fields.
- `port` (Number) SMTP port. n8n defaults to 465 when omitted.
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the credential. Omit to use the API key owner's personal project. Changing a previously set value transfers the credential; setting it for the first time after import adopts without transfer.
- `secure` (Boolean) When true, use implicit SSL/TLS (typical for port 465).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `id` (String) Credential ID assigned by n8n.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) Whether n8n manages this credential. Managed credentials cannot be edited or deleted via the API.
- `resolvable_allow_fallback` (Boolean) Whether a credential resolver may fall back to static data.
- `resolver_id` (String) Dynamic credential resolver id, if any.
- `type` (String) n8n credential type (`smtp`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import n8n_credential_smtp.example <credential-id>
```
